purpose: Cover AC-16201-1 (UI-BASELINE-UNMET refusal, C-28 + C-36), AC-16201-2 (BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING refusal, C-29) and AC-16201-3 (SCOPE-MISMATCH refusal, C-30). Each test scaffolds a fresh RCF project with initProject, wires a stub verify subprocess that writes a passing report carrying the named per-AC verdict, invokes rcf build finalise, and asserts exit 4 with the expected stderr message.
title: finalise per-AC refusals: UI-BASELINE-UNMET, BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING, SCOPE-MISMATCH

testCases.description: Fresh project via initProject with FBS-001 at complete; stub verify writes a passing report with perAcVerdicts = [{acId: AC-101-1, verdict: UI-BASELINE-UNMET}]; invoke rcf build finalise; assert exit 4, FBS at complete, stderr matches /UI-BASELINE-UNMET/ and /Referee-guarantees claims C-28 and C-36/.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-referee-refusals.test.js::finalise refuses to promote on a passing verify report that carries UI-BASELINE-UNMET (referee-guarantees C-28, C-36)

testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-referee-refusals.test.js::finalise refuses to promote on a passing verify report that carries BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING (referee-guarantees C-29)
